title: Three Autumns and One Short Frame
subtitle: 遗产保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 遗产保护（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化遗产与保护）
meta: 主题语境：遗产保护（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化遗产与保护）　|　核心词汇：heritage　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 heritage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the guardian ① recorded the heritage that no official in the archive would have described, and he said the recording was the whole of the year. The ② heritage, meaning the past itself and not the frame, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; heritage, he said, is the only thing in a archive that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ piece of heritage in that archive had the same short frame beside it, and the ④ heritage at the far hall, meaning the custom they kept for the children to inherit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Heritage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the guardian said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the heritage was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the past. The ⑥ heritage, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; heritage, he said, is either something you record or the only word that means both past and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ heritage had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short frame. The ⑧ heritage of the whole thing, the guardian wrote in October, was one archive and three years of describing; heritage, he said, is either the custom at the far hall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ heritage I remember is the heritage described in the register, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the archive. ⑩ Heritage, my mother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being described; all heritage, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like past. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 遗产；传统（指档案馆里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 遗产；传统（指那份过往本身，与画框相对）
C. 固定搭配：record the heritage 记录这段遗产
D. n. 遗产；传统（指留给孩子们继承的那一份）
E. n. 传承之事（抽象总称，指一处档案馆的遗产之事）
F. n. 遗产；传统（指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 责任、托付（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 托付（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: recorded the heritage that no official in the archive would have described
The heritage, meaning the past itself and not the frame
Every piece of heritage in that archive
the heritage at the far hall
the heritage was the whole of the matter

The heritage of the whole thing

answers.why: record the heritage 意为“记录这段遗产”，1967 年那位守护人把档案馆里没有一位官员肯描述的这份遗产做了一遍。
heritage 意为“遗产；传统”，指那份过往本身而不是画框，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被描述。
heritage 意为“遗产；传统”，指档案馆里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一只窄窄的画框。
heritage 意为“遗产；传统”，指最远那间展厅留给孩子们继承的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
heritage 意为“责任、托付”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份责任就是那件事的全部。
heritage 意为“托付”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份过往，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
heritage 意为“遗产；传统”，指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1972 年这一份成了登记册里的一行。
heritage 意为“传承之事”，守护人十月写道，整件事的遗产之事是一处档案馆和三个年的描述。
heritage 意为“遗产；传统”，我记得的是登记册里描述过的那一份，1974 年封存了，至今仍被说成档案馆里最安静的一份。
heritage 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，遗产是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的过往。
